I told Hollis in their thread that the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47.

GBrain has Gate 47 as the only current fact for the account. #central-team, which Hollis is in, shows the same history: Pree posted Dock 23 on Oct 14, corrected it to Gate 47 the same day, and nobody has changed it since.

One mistake on my part: I used "she" for Pree in the reply to Hollis and in the note I wrote when I withdrew the old Dock 23 fact. Pree's pronouns were never stated. I don't have a tool to edit a posted message, so the reply stays as it is. In future I'll use their name or "they."
